correctness.rationale: The first noncoinciding base-p input digit occurs at j=nu_p(x-y). Lucas gives identical output digits for all indices below p^j and different digits at exactly p^j, so the valuation is p^j. The digit map extends continuously to all Z_p; positions p^j recover each input digit. This proves image, finite quotient, uniform pushforward measure and dimension; all endpoints checked. Exact independent finite sanity checks passed 12,960+9,800+42 cases.
